events.content:
I have implemented a new server component `ThemeInfo` in `app/components/ThemeInfo.tsx`. This component retrieves the user's theme preference from the `theme` cookie (defaulting to 'light' if not present) and displays their preferred language from the `Accept-Language` header. I have also integrated this component into the main page at `app/page.tsx`.

The implementation uses the `next/headers` API, leveraging the asynchronous `cookies()` and `headers()` functions available in recent Next.js versions.
